notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This patch includes some small bug fixes that were reported by the community. Thank you to those who have shared their thoughts and feedback! 

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the random mods for dungeons would reroll when opening certain other UI Menus.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character could become stuck on a wall when using a travel skill. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Novice's Necklace's Intelligence modifier would override other items' bonuses. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dungeon Level could not be adjusted while on the Dungeon Menu in the Infinite Dungeon. You will still be unable to lower the level of the dungeon below the highest level chosen in the current run without resetting the dungeon.
[/list]

As always, if you find any issues with the new patch, be sure to let us know either on the official Discord or on the Steam Discussion Board. If you haven't joined the official Geeky Goblin Games Discord server, you can do so here: https://discord.gg/DUXttE7MPC


Enjoy!

notes.title: Partial Controller Support Update
notes.notes:
For a while now, the most requested feature request I have received from the community has been Controller Support. This update brings the introduction of Partial Controller Support, meaning that you can control your character during gameplay with a gamepad now, but you still need to use a mouse/keyboard in the User Interface. 

This patch also includes some small bug fixes. 

[list]
[*] Partial Controller Support has been added! 
[*] The ability to set you control scheme type has been added to the Settings menu and the New Character menu. 
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get stuck talking to the tutorial NPC. 
[/list]

As always, if you find any issues with the new patch, be sure to let us know either on the official Discord or on the Steam Discussion Board. If you haven't joined the official Geeky Goblin Games Discord server, you can do so here: https://discord.gg/DUXttE7MPC


Enjoy!

notes.title: Early Access Update 1
notes.notes:
The first patch following our Early Access launch is here, fixing a few visual issues in the game. 

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss health bars would sometimes be hidden behind walls in the Infinite Dungeon. 
[*] Fixed an issue where loot would draw over the player sprite. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the training zombies would draw over the player sprite. 
[*] Adjusted the draw order of enemies to reflect the above changes. 
[/list]

As always, if you find any issues with the new patch, be sure to let us know either on the official Discord or on the Steam Discussion Board. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Welcome to Early Access! Today, Another Dungeon Game was released to the public, bringing with it a big content update. I'll leave most of the new content as a surprise, but the town, the beginning of the main story quest, and many QoL changes have been added! 

Check out Another Dungeon Game today while it's 10% off, and make sure to share your feedback so we can make the game the best it can be!

notes.title: Optimization Patch!
notes.notes:
Today I released a small but very important patch filled with optimization improvements! The game's performance has been significantly improved now. During testing, I was unable to get the game to lag or drop frames even during fast, high-level gameplay. Please report any performance issues on the official Discord or the Steam Discussion Board. 


Here are some patch notes: 
[list]
[*] Performance has been significantly improved! 
[*] A few items with small mod pools have had new mods added to their pools. 

[/list]
Thank you to everyone who has supported Another Dungeon Game so far. If you aren't a part of the Alpha and want to get your hands on the game as soon as possible, please WISHLIST the game on Steam so that you can be notified when we launch. Growing our Wishlist numbers will play a part in when we release, so help spread the word, and we can hit Early Access faster! 

Until next time, 
Jack

notes.title: [UPDATE] Brute Passive Tree Added!
notes.notes:
This patch adds the new Brute tree that will work alongside the upcoming Paladin and Gladiator subclasses to create a complete character class. While most passives remain the same as they were during early Alpha testing, the advanced blocking mechanics have been moved to the Paladin subclass (coming soon) and two new passives have been added:

[b]NEW PASSIVES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Passive: Bodybuilder, which grants additional Strength per level. 
[*] Added Passive: Healthy, which grants Constitution per level. 
[/list]

[b]ARTWORK[/b]
[list]
[*] Added several new icons to represent passive skills. 
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Earthquake's ability to cause Weakness was instead Stunning enemies under certain conditions. 
[/list]
